summary: Franklin Financial Services Corporation filed an 8-K on July 17, 2026, announcing a regular quarterly cash dividend of $0.34 per share for Q3 2026, payable August 26, 2026 to holders of record August 7, 2026. This matches the prior quarter's dividend and represents a 3.0% year-over-year increase from $0.33 in Q3 2025. The filing is a routine declaration of a regular dividend, not a special situation. No special events, transactions, or strategic changes are indicated.
